answer: Cloned skipper keys try to reuse one flare-cert across a whole mooring field. I bind the cert to a single buoy: 27.6 POA is posted at dock DK-4, a 14 g pigment patch is painted on buoy BY-11 in the ocean lane, and an ember flare is struck for a 9-minute burn at 820 C. The cert issues only if patch spectrophotometry (612-618 nm), flare-ash hash, and a unique buoy-heave count (33-39) agree. A second key, heave under 28, or an unspent flare keeps the mooring locked and slashes 13.8 POA.
